changelog: Turn a written visitor reception script into one visitor reception voice clip per labeled cue.

en.description: Turn a written visitor reception script into one visitor reception voice clip per labeled cue. This front desk voice studio records each reception script audio and visitor greeting voice from the script the desk already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 visitor desk voice pack files. Use it for visitor reception voice packs that keep one cue on each clip.
en.summary: Turn a written visitor reception script into one visitor reception voice clip per labeled cue.
en.title: Visitor Desk Voice: Reception Script Clips
